content.comment_body: [article_no] [product_name], 8DI/4DO Hello, I am trying to configure this hardware online. Which [product_name] software version should I use? Please advise.

All selectable [product_name] versions are supported by your software. Hope this clears things up.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing which software version is compatible with specific hardware, notably [product_name] ([article_no]). Although the user has the latest software version (V8), they are unable to configure the hardware, possibly due to confusion or issues in hardware selection options within the program. Other users confirm that the relevant hardware versions ([article_no], [article_no].ES3, [article_no].ES10) are indeed supported, but this feedback does not resolve the user's original problem.
